description: Vehicle speed dataset for the major European road network derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, 2022–2026 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Maciej Adamiak, Sascha Fendrich (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology (HeiGIT)). The dataset provides individual vehicle speed observations on European E-roads: motorways, trunk roads, primary and secondary roads, as tagged in OpenStreetMap as e-roads, for the years 2022-2026. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is LICENSE. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
